task:
Review Student 5 (Travel Logistics & Advisory) Release 2 Multi-Agent workflow evidence: the multi-agent report covering two Chunk 2 UI workflows and two Chunk 6 workflows (one from the Student 5 UI, decided as a correction; one from the terminal with cli.py, decided as a partial acceptance), the terminal run and decision transcripts and the audit-chain verification. Check roles, evidence boundaries, human decisions and audit verification, and recommend report corrections.

Review the supplied evidence using review-multi-agent-v1.txt. Propose report findings and corrective actions, not source edits. Missing or failed evidence must remain explicit; only a human can make the release decision.

preTest.result: Reviewing supplied context files, not executing tests or deployment. Validate their provenance and results before human finalisation.
